prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, amazoness physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad; a commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist; enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves; powerful, statuesque and imposing; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long wavy copper red hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 41% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 4 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 38%, 56%, 79% and 91% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries Lichtenstein style pop-art Ben-Day dots and thick black outlines in primary red, yellow and blue. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries fluorescent UV neon paint in neon pink and acid lime lightning streaks, glowing intensely with a blacklight shimmer. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Mucha style Art Nouveau flowing floral curves with soft pastel flowers and ornamental whiplash lines. Region 4 is the ring between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries Klimt style golden spirals and mosaic squares with ornate gold, black and green geometric ornaments. Region 5 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries high-gloss enamel paint in ruby red and cobalt blue, a mirror-glossy coat with wet-looking highlights. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg, her legs fully in view — most extreme amazoness silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy pale blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her whole hand, in pale blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: wet-look glass skin glowing as if coated in clear gel, strong liquid highlighter on the cheekbones, nose bridge and the center of the forehead, a flushed rosy blush, high-shine glossy lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows medium body oil, moderate skin glistening, healthy oiled appearance.

Background: a vast white salt flat reflecting the sky with a smooth flat floor and a standard-height wooden doorway frame standing at her side, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
